about: Perplexity answers the static n8n-versus-Make question with two citations; Clean Output keeps the text and the citation list

search_results.title: n8n vs Make: workflow automation compared

message.content:
**n8n vs Make (formerly Integromat)**

1. **Hosting**: n8n can be self-hosted under its Sustainable Use License or used as n8n Cloud; Make is cloud-only [1][2].
2. **Pricing model**: Make bills per operation; n8n Cloud bills per workflow execution, so long workflows cost the same as short ones [1].
3. **Code**: n8n has Code nodes in JavaScript and Python and lets you write custom nodes; Make offers limited custom functions [1].
4. **AI**: n8n ships LangChain-based AI Agent, memory and vector store nodes [1].

In short, n8n suits teams that want control and code; Make suits teams that want a fully managed visual builder [2].
